summary: Iteration_823 fix verification (Feature 37 Flappy Bird — free user access). Backend fix in access_control_engine.py FREE_PATTERNS is CONFIRMED working: free user gets 200 on /api/flappy-bird/bootstrap, /score (with X-Requested-With), and /leaderboard; admin at rank #1 (best=9999), free user at #2 (best=15). All access-gate regressions pass: unauth->401, POST without custom header->403 CSRF_BLOCKED, sibling /api/games-station/bootstrap free user->200. Both backend test suites pass 17/17 (11 core + 6 extended) with ZERO xfails after one small pre-existing test-script assertion was corrected (admin already at 9999 ceiling). HOWEVER — CRITICAL FRONTEND MIRROR-GAP DETECTED: the UI route guard in /app/frontend/src/context/AccessControlContext.tsx has a hard-coded FREE_TIER_FEATURE_PREFIXES list (lines 49-53) that is missing /features/flappy-bird. Free user attempting to visit /features/flappy-bird in the browser is client-side-redirected to /subscription/plans?upgrade_reason=basic_required BEFORE any backend call is made, so none of the flappy-bird testids ever render. The backend fix is CORRECT and complete; the frontend allow-list must be updated in parallel to actually deliver the free-tier gameplay to users.

rca of the issue: The original bug (iter823) was a missing entry in the BACKEND access_control_engine.FREE_PATTERNS regex list. Main agent added r'^/api/flappy-bird/' — backend now correctly serves the free user (verified via curl: bootstrap 200, score POST 200, leaderboard 200 with correct ranking). But the platform has a PARALLEL frontend allow-list (FREE_TIER_FEATURE_PREFIXES in AccessControlContext.tsx) that must mirror the backend, and that list was NEVER updated. Reproduction: 1) login as free user 2) visit /features/flappy-bird 3) frontend RouteAccessGuard evaluates canAccessRoute() → not in FREE_TIER_FEATURE_PREFIXES and under /features/* which is in BASIC_UI_PREFIXES → redirect to /subscription/plans with upgrade_reason=basic_required. Mitigation: add '/features/flappy-bird' to FREE_TIER_FEATURE_PREFIXES list in AccessControlContext.tsx (1-line change, exact mirror of the backend fix).
